item.text: {"hypothesis_status":"not_supported","summary":"L009 executed successfully but failed both eligibility criteria. Its pooled weighted OOF MAE was 8.5585 K versus A05's 7.7526 K, a deterioration of 0.8059 K rather than the required gain of at least 0.01 K. Its positive-Tc MAE was 11.0373 K, exceeding the fixed G01 guard of 8.8322 K by 2.2051 K, so it cannot be called an eligible win. Relative to A05, reported-zero MAE improved sharply from 6.0806 K to 3.0508 K, but positive-Tc MAE worsened from 8.5051 K to 11.0373 K and high-Tc MAE from 28.8502 K to 48.9755 K. On cu_o specifically, log1p produced severe underprediction: positive-Tc MAE was 40.5124 K and high-Tc MAE was 54.8772 K, with several 92.8–95 K materials predicted near 4.6–6.2 K. Thus target compression reduced zero overprediction but catastrophically amplified the zero-versus-high-Tc tradeoff.","next_action":"continue","next_focus":"Because the required successful-unique-cycle minimum remains pending, test an untried target-only fe_anion specialization around A05: composition input, chemistry routing, global extra_trees/raw, cu_o extra_trees/raw, other extra_trees/raw, and fe_anion extra_trees/log1p. A01 showed that a route-specific extra_trees/raw fe_anion expert worsened A05, while L002 showed the same for hist_gradient_boosting/raw; this isolates whether target compression helps the smaller fe_anion route, where L009's unchanged fallback had reported-zero MAE of 11.2752 K, without disturbing A05's cu_o or other predictions. It is falsified as an eligible improvement unless pooled weighted OOF MAE is below 7.742598770753422 K and positive-Tc MAE remains at or below 8.832165507919859 K. Any reduction in reported-zero error that violates either condition is only a subgroup tradeoff.","stop_reason":"","limitations":["All measurements are adaptive development evidence from reused fixed-group training OOF folds, not independent validation or proof of generalization.","L009 failed the deterministic positive-Tc guard and the pooled improvement threshold.","Chemistry routes are operational composition partitions rather than verified physical material families.","The cu_o route has only 66 groups and exhibits severe zero-versus-high-Tc ambiguity.","Many allowed configurations remain untried; the evidence does not establish generalization or identify new superconductors."]}
